products.name: EduRestaurant Manager Software
products.tagline: Complete restaurant software: orders, billing, kitchen, stock and accounts.
products.audience: Restaurants, cafes, fast food outlets, takeaways and food chains.
intro: EduRestaurant Manager runs the whole restaurant from one system. Orders are taken at the counter, at the table or on the waiter's phone, go straight to the kitchen, and the bill is ready when the guest asks for it.
Behind the counter it keeps the menu, raw material stock, purchases, staff and accounts, so the owner sees sales, costs and profit for every day without adding anything up by hand.
features: Fast billing for dine-in, takeaway and delivery.
Table status, orders per waiter and bill splitting.
Orders printed or shown in the right kitchen section.
Items, sizes, add-ons, deals and price changes.
Raw material used per dish, so stock stays right.
Purchase orders, stock in and supplier balances.
Cash book, expenses, ledgers and day closing.
Item-wise, waiter-wise, hour-wise and daily profit.
faq: Can waiters take orders on a phone?
Yes. The Restaurant Manager Android app sends orders from the table straight to the kitchen.
Does it work for more than one branch?
Yes. Each branch has its own sales and stock, and the owner sees all of them.
Do I need to install anything?
No. It runs in the browser; open the demo with the login shown.
workflow: Set up the menu, deals, tables and kitchen sections once.
Take a dine-in, takeaway or delivery order. The kitchen gets its order ticket (KOT) instantly.
Print the bill with discounts and taxes, and take cash, card or credit.
Stock is reduced by recipe, and the day closes with sales, cash and profit reports.
modules: Table plan with free, occupied and billing status
Bill split, merge and transfer between tables
Discounts, service charge and tax on the bill
Order status from kitchen to table
Void and change tracking with reason
Raw materials and recipes for every dish
Stock in from purchases, stock out by sale
Wastage, low-stock alerts and stock counts
Day closing with cash in hand

products.name: EduBS RT
products.tagline: Business Solution for retail stores: billing, stock in, stock out and accounts.
products.audience: Retail shops, marts, superstores and stores with one or more counters.
intro: EduBS RT (Business Solution, Retail) is built for retail stores. Counter billing, purchases, stock in and stock out, customer and supplier accounts and financial reports all run in one system.
Every sale reduces stock and posts to accounts automatically, so the owner always knows what is on the shelf, what is owed, and what the store earned today.
features: Barcode billing on one or more counters.
Purchase orders, purchase invoices and returns.
Every movement recorded with date and reason.
Current stock, minimum levels and reorder lists.
Credit sales, receipts and customer ledgers.
Cash book, bank accounts and expenses.
Daily sales, profit and loss, balance sheet.
faq: What does RT stand for?
Retail. EduBS RT is the retail edition of Edusoft Business Solution.
Can it run several counters?
Yes. Each counter bills on its own and closes its own cash.
Can I try it now?
Yes. Open the demo with the login shown.
workflow: Add items with barcode, category, purchase and sale price.
Record purchases from suppliers. Stock comes in and the supplier's balance updates.
Sell at the counter with a barcode scanner. Stock goes out and the sale posts to accounts.
Check stock, receivables, payables and profit from the reports.
modules: Barcode billing and quick item search
Stock in, stock out and stock transfer
Low stock and fast/slow moving items

products.name: EduBS Standard
products.tagline: Business Solution for distribution and trading businesses.
intro: EduBS Standard is built for distribution businesses. It covers order booking, deliveries, salesmen and routes, stock in the warehouse, and the full finance side: customers, suppliers, banks and financial statements.
Orders booked in the field turn into invoices and deliveries, stock and accounts update by themselves, and recoveries are tracked against every shop.
features: Orders by salesman, route and shop.
Purchases from companies, with claims and returns.
Warehouse stock, transfers and batch tracking.
Trade offers, bonuses and price lists.
Credit limits, recoveries and shop-wise balances.
Bank accounts, cheques, vouchers and ledgers.
Sales, stock, profit and financial statements.
faq: Is this the same as the desktop EduBS?
It is the same Business Solution, in the standard (distribution) edition, running in the browser.
Does it work with the Android app?
Yes. Salesmen can book orders on the Business Solution app.
Can I try it now?
Yes. Open the demo with the login shown.
workflow: Set up products, companies (principals), customers, salesmen and routes.
Book orders in the field or in the office, and turn them into sales invoices.
Load and deliver goods; stock goes out of the warehouse and receivables update.
Record recoveries and bank deposits, and close the month with financial reports.
modules: Stock in from purchases, stock out on delivery
Trial balance, profit and loss, balance sheet

products.name: EduCampus Manager
products.tagline: School and college management: admissions, attendance, fees, exams and staff.
products.audience: Schools, colleges, academies and school systems with several campuses.
intro: EduCampus Manager runs a school or college from admission to result card. Student records, class attendance, fee vouchers, exams, timetables and staff are kept in one system that every campus shares.
Principals see attendance, fee collection and results for each class and campus, and parents can be informed by SMS without extra work for the office.
features: Inquiry, admission form, documents and student ID cards.
Profile, guardian details, history and promotions.
Daily student and staff attendance with SMS to parents.
Fee vouchers in bulk, concessions, fines and defaulters.
Marks entry, grading and printed result cards.
Several campuses in one system, with combined reports.
faq: Can it run several campuses?
Yes. Each campus has its own classes and fees, and management sees all of them together.
Can parents get SMS alerts?
Yes, for attendance, fee dues and results.
Can I try it now?
Yes. Open the demo with the login shown.
workflow: Set up campuses, classes, sections, subjects and the fee structure.
Admit students; each gets a record, roll number and fee plan.
Mark daily attendance, print fee vouchers and record collections.
Enter exam marks and print result cards, with reports for each class and campus.

products.name: Digital Invoicing (FBR)
products.tagline: FBR digital invoices with HS codes and provincial tax handled.
products.audience: Sales-tax registered businesses that must issue FBR digital invoices.
intro: Made for Pakistan's FBR digital invoicing requirement. HS codes, units of measure and the correct provincial sales tax are applied automatically, and each invoice is validated before it goes out.
workflow: Set up your products with their HS codes once.
Create the invoice. Tax type and rates are filled in for the buyer's province.
The invoice is validated and submitted.
Keep the digital record for reporting.
features: Codes applied automatically, so you aren't typing them.
Picks the right tax type for each province.
modules: Sales tax invoices and debit/credit notes
Tax filled in automatically for each item
QR code on the printed invoice

products.name: EduFuel Manager
products.tagline: Fuel station software: nozzles, tanks, shifts, credit customers and accounts.
products.audience: Petrol pumps, CNG stations, fuel dealers and oil depots.
intro: EduFuel Manager keeps every litre accounted for. Nozzle meter readings and tank dips are recorded each shift, and the system matches litres sold against cash collected.
Fuel purchases, lubricant sales, credit customers, staff and expenses are all in the same place, with daily sales, stock and profit for the owner.
features: Opening and closing readings per nozzle per shift.
Dip readings, stock and gain or loss.
Cash, card and credit for each shift and attendant.
Fleet and company accounts with limits and statements.
New rates applied from a set date and time.
Oil, lubricant and tuck shop sales.
Daily sales, stock, expenses and profit.
faq: When can I try the demo?
The live demo link is coming soon. Message us on WhatsApp and we'll show it to you.
Does it work for CNG stations too?
Yes. Products and units are set up for each station.
workflow: Set up tanks, dispensers, nozzles, products and rates.
At each shift, enter opening and closing meter readings; sales are worked out by nozzle.
Record cash, card and credit sales and the shift's cash handover.
Record tank dips and fuel received; see stock gain or loss and daily profit.

products.name: Edu Enterprise
products.tagline: Enterprise ERP: manufacturing, inventory, sales, purchase, finance and HR.
products.audience: Manufacturers and growing companies with several departments or branches.
intro: Edu Enterprise is a full ERP for companies that make and sell. Production, raw material and finished goods stock, purchasing, sales, finance and HR run in one system, so every department works from the same numbers.
Management sees costs, stock, receivables and profit across the whole company, branch by branch and department by department.
features: Bills of material, production orders and costing.
Raw material, work in progress and finished goods.
Requisitions, purchase orders, receiving and returns.
Quotations, sales orders, invoices and deliveries.
General ledger, banks, payables and receivables.
Cost, stock, sales and profit dashboards.
faq: When can I try the demo?
The live demo link is coming soon. Message us on WhatsApp and we'll show it to you.
Can it be set up for our process?
Yes. Edu Enterprise is configured for each company's products, departments and approvals.
workflow: Set up products, bills of material, warehouses, departments and the chart of accounts.
Purchase raw material; it comes into the store against the purchase order.
Issue material to production, record output, and move finished goods into stock.
Sell and dispatch; accounts, costing and reports update across the company.
modules: Stock in, stock out and transfers

products.name: Edu Pharmacy Manager
products.tagline: Pharmacy ERP: counter billing, batch and expiry, purchases and accounts.
products.audience: Medical stores, pharmacies, pharmacy chains and hospital pharmacies.
intro: Edu Pharmacy Manager runs the pharmacy from the counter to the accounts. Every medicine is tracked by batch and expiry, so the right stock is sold first and nothing expires on the shelf unnoticed.
Purchases, supplier returns, stock between branches and the day's cash are all in one system, with reports the owner can check at any time.
features: Fast sales by barcode, brand or generic name.
Stock by batch, expiry alerts and near-expiry lists.
Purchase invoices, bonuses and returns to suppliers.
Minimum levels and automatic reorder lists.
Supplier ledgers, cash book and expenses.
Sales, profit, stock value and expiry reports.
faq: When can I try the demo?
The live demo link is coming soon. Message us on WhatsApp and we'll show it to you.
Can it handle more than one branch?
Yes. Each branch has its own stock, and transfers move stock between them.
workflow: Add medicines with generic name, pack size, batch and expiry.
Receive purchases from distributors; stock comes in by batch.
Bill at the counter with barcode or name search; the oldest batch goes out first.
Get expiry alerts, reorder lists and the day's sales and profit.
modules: Batch-wise stock in and stock out
